text: :Of course Le Mans is the official brand of the city of Le Mans: the brand's Bluesky account (:Of course Le Mans) is the 'Compte officiel de la ville du Mans'.
short: :Of course Le Mans is the official brand of the Ville du Mans / Le Mans Métropole.
